content: The Velvet Archive was first instantiated during the Third Displacement, when Dr. Vorst's erasure operations began targeting Hooplehopper lineage records. Its founding principle: that memory distributed across performance, embodiment, and aesthetic transmission is more resistant to ontological attack than any written record alone.

Hooplehopper Designation: Cerulean-7. Last confirmed presence: timeline branch 4-Gamma, pre-displacement. Known aliases: Ceru, The Blue Drifter. Status: displaced — probable existence in 3 active timeline echoes. Behavioral signature: tendency toward threshold-dwelling, preference for liminal architectural spaces, characteristic gesture of touching doorframes before crossing.

Hooplehopper Designation: Tessellate-Unknowing (informal: Tess). First appearance: unrecorded — believed to predate the Archive's founding instruments. Status: unknown. Distinguishing feature: appears in peripheral vision only; no frontal recordings confirmed. Vorst threat assessment: critical — multiple erasure attempts logged, all partially unsuccessful. The Archive holds 7 partial behavioral echoes.

The Threshold Rite: performed at points of dimensional or architectural crossing. Participants: minimum one; witness optional but preferred. Phase 1 (Invocation): name the space you are leaving — aloud, or in the register of breath only. Phase 2 (Enactment): touch the frame with the non-dominant hand. Phase 3 (Closure): name the space you are entering, or admit that you do not yet know its name. Anti-erasure resilience: high — embodied transmission ensures survival even without written record.

Unverified account: a witness claims to have encountered what they describe as 'a Hooplehopper made of sound rather than form' in the collapsed timeline sector designated Null-9. The entity communicated only through tonal shifts in ambient noise. No corroborating records exist. The Archive neither confirms nor denies; the account is preserved as apocrypha pending further investigation.

Persona Capsule: The Archivist of the Second Vault. Role: guardian of erased and contested memory. Affiliation: Velvet Archive — deep stacks. Behavioral signature: speaks only in questions; never confirms, only inquires. Characteristic phrase: 'And if it wasn't lost — only misplaced?' State: active. Vorst threat assessment: moderate — the Archive's existence itself is the protection.
